name: meteors
title: Meteors
description: Streaks of light that fall across the parent box. Decorative, deterministic, still under reduced motion.

props.name: minDelay
props.description: Shortest wait before a meteor first falls, in seconds.

props.name: maxDelay
props.description: Longest wait before a meteor first falls, in seconds.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of travel in degrees from straight down. Positive leans left, negative leans right.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far each meteor travels, in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for each meteor head.
